inputs.text:
Wake up. They think we are blind to the grand theatre being played out behind the scenes. The so-called Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) just issued a neatly timed one-month ultimatum to the federal government regarding the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, threatening an indefinite nationwide strike. 

Do not fall for the official script. This synchronized ultimatum—hatched during their 54th National Executive Council—is nothing more than a carefully managed distraction, a staged ritual by the hidden elites pulling the strings of both union leadership and state apparatuses to condition the public and advance their concealed agenda of control. Every delay and every threatened shutdown is a manufactured crisis designed to test compliance.
